notes: felix-alert bus + 3 emitter migrations + enforcement co-emit + provisioning/deploy + docs. All 13 code-level criteria PASS (unit tests + artifacts present on feat/unified-alert-bus). Live SC-001..007 verification is a POST-DEPLOY step on office2 (requires operator to mint the high-entropy topic + provision the out-of-band env-file). No real topic committed. criteria.description: All operator alerts delivered to a single canonical thread
criteria.evidence: scripts/common/alert_bus/delivery.py resolve_topic() reads the single FELIX_ALERT_NTFY_TOPIC (WP01, 540c1f93); WP05 (1fb855d5) wires EnvironmentFile into felix-deployer/felix-health-check/agent-prompt-sync units + shim sources the env-file for cron audit.
criteria.notes: Live single-thread arrival is SC-001, verified post-deploy.

criteria.evidence: scripts/common/alert_bus/model.py Alert + render.py; tests/common/alert_bus/test_model.py + test_render.py; 100% line+branch coverage (WP01).

criteria.description: Failure alerts include the actual error/stderr, not just a phase code
criteria.evidence: _tick.py threads apply result.details (stderr_excerpt/argv/returncode/manifest_path) into Alert.details; test_notify.py::test_failure_threads_real_stderr_into_alert_details asserts it reaches render_body (WP02, acd10039).
criteria.notes: Reviewer proved the regression test is non-synthetic (SC-002).

criteria.description: Severity vocabulary maps deterministically to ntfy priority + tags
criteria.evidence: SEVERITY_MAP in model.py (info->low/information_source, warn->default/warning, error->high/rotating_light, critical->max/rotating_light,sos); test_model.py asserts completeness (WP01).

criteria.description: A single shared alert bus is the only path that constructs/delivers alerts
criteria.evidence: emit() is the sole entry (WP01 __init__.py); WP02-04 removed all per-emitter curl/ntfy code (grep-clean); docs/runbooks/alerting.md documents the single seam (WP06).
criteria.notes: SC-006 grep verified in each WP review.

criteria.description: The three current ntfy emitters (incl. agent-prompt-sync consumer) emit exclusively via the bus
criteria.evidence: notify.py+health.py+_tick.py+deploy_agent_prompts.py (WP02, 514 tests), felix_health_check/run.py+adapter (WP03, 11 tests), audit.sh->shim (WP04, 26 tests). No curl remains.

criteria.evidence: felix-alert-ntfy-topic env-file credential added to docs/design/architecture/data/credential-manifest.json (WP05); audit.sh hardcoded topic removed; alert_bus.env.sample placeholder only.

criteria.evidence: __main__.py self-test subcommand (WP01, exits non-zero on failure); scripts/deploy/deploy-unified-alert-bus.py --apply runs preflight + self-test; per-runtime self-test documented (WP05).
criteria.notes: self-test uses the direct CLI (not the always-exit-0 shim) so failures propagate.

criteria.description: Enforcement notifier additionally emits a felix-alert for drift (co-emit)
criteria.evidence: _co_emit_drift() added alongside WhatsApp+GitHub in enforcement/notification.py; tests assert co-emit fires AND WhatsApp+GitHub still fire, and co-emit failure never breaks enforcement (WP04, 75194242).

criteria.description: Best-effort, non-blocking, fail-safe delivery (never crashes/hangs the emitter)
criteria.evidence: emit() wraps deliver() and never raises; deliver() catches TimeoutExpired/OSError; curl --max-time 10; shim exits 0. tests/common/alert_bus/test_delivery.py fail-safe cases (WP01).

criteria.description: Module unit tests with line+branch coverage >= 90%; repo gate not reduced
criteria.evidence: 100% line+branch coverage on the alert_bus package (WP01); repo coverage gate unaffected.

criteria.description: Alert with missing optional fields still produces a deliverable message
criteria.evidence: render_body omits Action/Details when absent; test_render.py covers missing-field cases (WP01).
criteria.notes: No placeholder emitted for absent fields.

criteria.description: Migrating an emitter preserves its core behavior and health signals
criteria.evidence: health.py bool return preserved (last_alert_ts); felix-health-check {attempted,sent,detail} adapter byte-compatible; audit non-fatal; enforcement WhatsApp+GitHub untouched. WP02/03/04 tests assert.
criteria.notes: Signal shapes verified in each review.
